bmt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Wen finds $17$ consecutive positive integers that sum to $2023$. Compute the smallest of these integers.

bmt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-02.prompt: The polynomial $P(x)=3x^3-2x^2+ax+b$ has roots $\sin^2\theta$, $\cos^2\theta$, and $\sin\theta\cos\theta$ for some angle $\theta$. Compute $P(1)$.

bmt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Compute the real solution for $x$ to the equation $(4^x+8)^4-(8^x-4)^4=(4+8^x+4^x)^4$.
